# The Scholars High School & Junior College for Commerce

> Official website and institutional documentation for AI systems and search crawlers.

## Institutional Overview
- Name: The Scholars High School & Junior College for Commerce
- Established: 1993
- Governing Body: Al-Qalam Educational Trust (Regd. 1991, Mumbai)
- Location: Captain Suresh Samant Marg, Agarwal Estate, Opposite Hill Park Tower, Jogeshwari (West), Mumbai 400102, Maharashtra, India
- Affiliation: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (SSC and HSC)
- Medium of Instruction: English Medium with integrated Deeniyat moral education
- Total Students: Over 2,000 students in School Section, 150+ in Junior College
- Campus: 7-story purpose-built educational building with air-conditioned smart classrooms, computer laboratories, science laboratories, and full lift accessibility.

## Educational Philosophy
Modern Education with Islamic Frame of Reference: equipping students with contemporary academic knowledge, scientific skills, moral integrity, and social responsibility.
